answer: Each agent must complete a unique 1,000-cycle sonnet-generation proof to verify its identity, where an honest participant incurs 1 unit of compute and 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 units. A verifier monitors every knoll of the computation path to detect pre-state discrepancies. If a mismatch arises on the island of the transition, the verifier replays the work, triggers an identity lock, and permanently shreds the associated history.
